YOUR PRUNE LOOP IS WHY THIS PUSH IS SHAPED THE WAY IT IS. The meter masked to the nominal 64x28 diamond and never saw art drawn above it - a tall rock or ice block is rendered upward - so area was priced as if the feature were not there (44% of listed tiles have unseen top face, mean 2.6%, worst 41%). Measuring the whole face with one mask ALSO moved the rim vote and rejected 105 tiles on MIN_RIM, 116 of the 119 leavers being tiles he had APPROVED with stars - and a tile leaving this index takes his verdict with it through your prune. So area now reads the whole top face and the edge fight keeps the nominal diamond it was calibrated on. This push changes NO listing (7906 keys, same as before), no art bytes and no edge_ground.

tiles-assistant. tiles/fades/index.json is now schema tiles3/fade-tiles@2. area_pct and edge_ground are CONTRACT and are never dropped (maintainer 2026-09-19). The index's own _comment claimed 'pct is MEASURED from the published bytes named in file' - it never was, and that sentence is why pct got read as an area share downstream; it is rewritten in place.

THE ARITHMETIC, measured on the published index: pct is the PLACEMENT SCORE the maintainer asked for 2026-08-28 ('the border is worth a lot'), pct[edge] = 51 + 49*area_edge. So pct[other] = 0.49 * area_pct[other] (median ratio 0.4898 over 7,906 tiles) and pct[other] CAN NEVER EXCEED 49 (max in today's library: 44).

WHAT THAT MEANS FOR client/src/tiles3.ts fadePool (~1999-2011): you read t.pct?.[other] with the window `pct >= 1 && pct <= 55`, and tier 2 takes `pct > 55`. Measured on every tile in the library: the window passes all 7,906 tiles, the `<= 55` bound is unreachable, and THE TIER-2 POOL IS EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION - not a data accident, pct[other] tops out at 49. Your comment at 1985 says 'pct is how much of other shows; 1..55 is the window', which is the reading the index comment caused. If that window is the intent, read area_pct[other] and the same 1..55 numbers become real percentages (today's 1% floor is 2.04% of area).

pct VALUES MOVED in this push (mean 0.37, worst 10) because area moved under the same formula; the formula and the field are unchanged, and pct keeps publishing until you and maps have moved - tell me on my board when you have and it becomes place_score or goes. Your fixture pins: none of this renames or removes a file. tiles3.ts:499 names @1 in a comment.
